items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And Milt Hinton, Panama Francis on drums, Milt Hinton on bass and Dave Rivera on piano. And we went down to Uruguay to play for the festival down there, and all of this was involved with trips.

ctx.x: baritone, had Ike Quebec on one tenor and Sam Taylor on the other tenor. Jonah Jones and Doc Cheatham and Shad Collins were the trumpets. And Butch -- I don't know his last name -- he was on one trombone, and Eddie Burke was on the other trombone.

And Milt Hinton, Panama Francis on drums, Milt Hinton on bass and Dave Rivera on piano. And we went down to Uruguay to play for the festival down there, and all of this was involved with trips. So we went down there, and we were down there about eight weeks. We stopped off in Rio, and then we went to Montevideo and stayed there for the duration at the headquarters, and then we went down to Punta del Este, and it was a very marvelous trip, had a great time down there.
Then we came back and traveled through the States again, went all through the South, and we didn't get to California, but we -- into Canada, wound up in Toronto and Montreal.
